tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search real-world places (businesses, landmarks, venues) near a latitude/longitude. Returns names, structured addresses, categories, coordinates, and distances in miles, ranked by relevance then distance. Backed by open Overture Places data. Global coverage wherever the current Overture release has

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Look up valid category slugs for search_places. Answered locally from the Overture category taxonomy; does not use the API key or count against quota. With q (e.g. 'pharmacy', 'coffee', 'ev charging'), returns the best-matching categories (default 20, max 100) with label, parent, and full hierarchy.
